The S&P rating action clearly states the financing mix: ~$2.0B equity and a new $2.8B two-year term loan [Actual – S&P Global Ratings, Dec 2025].

6. **Tax rate:** the pack warns the inputs are broken. I use 22% [Assumption], consistent with ITT's effective tax rate history.
